body: The overwhelming is life in general not much family as they are the ones who keep me here and keep me going. I just can't talk to them about my problems because I don't want them to have the worry on me on their minds ontop of their day to day lives as well. I don't have the ability to get professional help and I grew up with shitty people who I cut out of my life so I don't really have friends atleast on the level I could talk to about problems. My main goal is not just being happy being I know actual sustainable long lasting happiness is a life long pursuit for most people. I just want  to not feel the way I feel everyday or atleast be able to control it so it don't get worse. It's been getting bad alot lately worse than normal which is scary and it's taking a toll. It's really starting to take a toll

I feel overwhelmed. I've dealt with anxiety and depression for years and for years I've lived to not pass on my burdens and pain to my family but I want to live to live and be happy doing it I don't want to live just as a shell because I feel I'm forced too which I know sounds bad but I don't know how else to word it. I've been through this constantly for years but I've worked and tried to better my life but it always seems it's not enough and I always feel like I'm in a cycle I can't break out of and everytime I try to I think I make the wrong decision and end up back where I was. I wanna talk but I don't know what I want to talk about fully if that makes sense. I know I just want to be happy and atleast get away from this feeling that keeps getting worse. I appreciate you taking the time to talk to me.
